podcast.title: Formation and Independence
podcast.body: Inhaler is a four-piece band that started in 2012, with all members still in their teens at the time. The group is deliberate about not seeking assistance from famous relatives, emphasizing their independent path. "Eli's band is called Inhaler. There are four pieces that started up in 2012 and all four members weren't even in their teens. No one in the group is interested in getting any help from famous relatives and vice versa."

xref.title: Band Philosophy and Independence
xref.body: Eli's band, Inhaler, formed in 2012 when all four members were still in their teens. The group is explicitly uninterested in receiving help from famous relatives, and vice versa. An anecdote illustrates this: when their Airbnb in London was unavailable, Eli called his mom for hotel suggestions, to which she jokingly replied, "well, there's always a park bench." They ended up staying with a friend. "Eli's band is called Inhaler. There are four pieces that started up in 2012 and all four members weren't even in their teens. No one in the group is interested in getting any help from famous relatives and vice versa. Eli tells a story about going to London and finding out that their Airbnb wasn't available. So Eli phoned mom and said, uh, do you know any good hotels in London? And mum replied, well, there's always a park bench. They ended up finding a friend and sleeping on the couch."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Sarcoidosis Diagnosis
xref.body: Matthew Good suffered from sarcoidosis, a disease that progressively affects different parts of the body, and for him, specifically his lungs. It causes lung tissue to turn into scar tissue over time, making it difficult to breathe, a condition also experienced by Bernie Mack. Matthew uses an inhaler but has avoided steroid treatments like prednisone due to their severe side effects. "Sarcoid osus. It's basically a disease that can affect different parts of your body. For me, it affects my lungs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Son of Bono
xref.body: Elijah Hewson is the frontman of the Irish indie band Inhaler and is the son of Paul Hewson, widely known as Bono. "inhaler, an Irish indie band fronted by Elijah Husson, son of Paul Husson, otherwise known as Bono."
